title: Pokedex-AI
description: **Pokédex-AI** is an educational computer vision project focused on Pokémon image classification using `TensorFlow` and `Keras`. It uses a custom dataset containing varied visual representations and explores both CNNs built from scratch and *transfer learning* approaches.
extendedDescription:
**Pokédex-AI** is an educational computer vision project focused on Pokémon image classification using deep learning. I built and prepared a custom dataset and trained *Convolutional Neural Networks* with `TensorFlow` and `Keras` to recognize Pokémon across different visual contexts, including figures, posters, trading cards, game screenshots, and sprites.
The project supports the recognition of **[23 Pokémon](https://github.com/Alwexis/Pokedex-AI#pokédex-list)** and explores two approaches to model development: a CNN architecture designed from scratch and *transfer learning* using a pre-trained model. It provided hands-on experience with dataset creation, image preprocessing, model architecture, fine-tuning, and evaluation.
